units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 6:2">Targ. Y. Gen. VI, 2</cite> <he>גִּילּוּי בשרא</he> nakedness.
Ib. XIII, 13; Num. XXXV, 25 ג׳ ערייתא = h. גִּילּוּי עריות.—Esp. liquids left uncovered, law concerning them.
<cite ref="Chullin 49b:12">Ḥull. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>כי הוה להו ג׳</he> when they had a case of uncovered liquids.
<cite ref="Gittin 69b:2">Gitt. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>לג׳ וכ׳</he> against the danger from drinking uncovered liquids apply &c.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 30a:14">Ab. Zar. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>אג׳ לא קפדי</he> they care not for the law concerning uncovered liquids; a. fr.—<he>גִּלּוּי דעתא</he> intimation of meaning.
<cite ref="Gittin 34a">Gitt. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>בג׳ ד׳ בגיטא וכ׳</he> they differ with regard to one intimating the annulment of a letter of divorce.
<cite ref="Zevachim 38b:1">Zeb. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>אַגִּילּוּיֵיה</he> on its (the altar’s) top surface cleared of ashes.—
Targ. Nah. II, 8 בגִילַּיָּא ed. Lag. (oth. ed. בגָלַיָּא) openly (not in a covered carriage), v. גְּלֵי.
